reviews.text:
I started going to AZDogSports in June of last year. The classes were great in the beginning. The puppy classes were pretty good until one of the instructors left.  I can't remember how many classes I bought in total. It was at least 24. I was going about twice a week with my puppy.  While I was there I kept trying to get the Puppy Star certification, but the instructor never did the testing. It was always "next" week. When we got to Obedience 1, it was always getting them to stay, a trip to the ACE Hardware, and then back for a course. I stopped early because I was having issues walking and that's really all it was. I had another dog pass away at the time. Instructor seemed more interested in the progression of other dogs. Spent part of one class watching a dog get their CGC. I didn't feel like any planning went into the classes. I ended up losing 4 credits, but really I was tired of driving 30 minutes to walk to ACE Hardware with no feedback. (Happy Hounds is the best deal)

What happed to the location? It's inside the Pet Supply Plus now... The outside images are inaccurate now...
Brought in a dog with aggressive problems for evaluation.  They were kind enough to bring in other dogs for the evaluation and were truthful about expectations.
